value.rationale: The diagonal coordinate swap is a canonical isometry of the central torus-grid Rips family. Its actual fixed set transitions, at a sharp and natural metric scale, from n components to a PL annulus with an essential loop and two boundary cycles. This structural equivariant fact is not a routine consequence of the known nonequivariant torus homotopy classification and gives a meaningful test case for equivariant persistent topology.
